chars.ME: ME: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black jogger trousers and white sneakers.
chars.SALMA: SALMA: a young woman wearing a red leather jacket over a white top, blue jeans and gold hoop earrings.
chars.NOUR: NOUR: a broad man wearing an olive-green bomber jacket, a thick gold chain necklace, black trousers and a black cap.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a modern apartment living room, ME secretly hides a tiny white security camera on a bookshelf, glancing back nervously, while SALMA sits on the sofa behind him looking at her phone with a sly suspicious smile. Tense, secretive mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: At the apartment front door, ME leaves for work carrying a laptop bag and waving goodbye; SALMA stands inside holding the door, smiling too sweetly, already reaching for her phone behind her back.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a bright modern coworking space with plants and big windows, ME sits at a desk working on a laptop next to a coffee cup, then glances at his phone lying on the desk.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Close view in the coworking space: ME stares at his phone in shock, eyes wide, mouth open, frozen; the phone screen glows showing a tiny blurry view of a living room (no text).

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Seen from a high security-camera angle in the apartment living room: SALMA lets NOUR in through the front door and he leans in to kiss her on the cheek, both smiling secretly. Slight grainy surveillance feel but still cartoon style.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In the apartment living room, SALMA and NOUR sit close together on the sofa laughing mockingly, NOUR with his arm on the sofa behind her, SALMA pointing at a framed photo of her boyfriend on the wall.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In the coworking space, ME stands up from his desk gripping his phone angrily, face furious and hurt, other desks blurred in the background.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night, ME sits alone on a bench outside the coworking building, head in his hands, phone on his knee, deep betrayal and confusion.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In a dim apartment kitchen, NOUR secretly hands SALMA a small knotted cloth pouch with dried herbs and a little glass vial, leaning close and whispering; SALMA takes it looking around nervously. Ominous dark-magic mood, candle on the counter.
